title: Verify creating an application requires company name
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Build an otherwise valid application payload. 2. Omit company_name. 3. Send POST /api/v1/applications.
expected_result: The response status is 422. The error code is VALIDATION_ERROR, error details are present, and the first detail identifies company_name as missing. No application is created.

title: Verify creating an application rejects an invalid remote type
preconditions: The application is running and an authenticated API client is available
steps: 1. Build an otherwise valid application payload. 2. Set remote_type to invalid_remote_type. 3. Send POST /api/v1/applications.
